record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare MORTAL_SPIN: Glimmet and Glimmora. The strategy is shared; values are indexed by the casting unit's stars. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Hits every enemy that is adjacent to the caster (8 neighbouring cells) AND is currently targeting the caster (the unit on the enemy's targetX/targetY cell is the caster). Each such enemy takes special damage from the caster (raw 20 / 40 / 80 / 160 by caster stars, i.e. the values listed per unit in perUnitRaw; scaled by x(1 + caster AP/100), a crit factor only with ABILITY_CRIT, then reduced by the victim's special defense with a minimum of 1), gets +1 poison stack with the caster as origin (duration 4000 / 4000 / 8000 / 16000 ms by caster stars, after duration reductions), and is pushed one row away: toward larger Y for a BLUE caster (if y+1 < 6), otherwise toward smaller Y (if y-1 > 0), and its cooldown is set to 500. The free-cell check always looks at (x, y+1) regardless of direction. Enemies adjacent but not targeting the caster are unaffected.

targeting.who: every enemy in the 8 cells around the caster whose current target cell contains the caster
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the default true, so the cast happens when the caster has a target in range; the caster's own target is not itself used in the strategy (only for the default animation). The "targeting" test is evaluated on each neighbour's targetX/targetY; cell values are captured by getAdjacentCells before any displacement happens.

geometry.shape: the 8 cells adjacent to the caster (center excluded; off-board cells skipped); filtered to enemies that target the caster

effects.target: each adjacent enemy that targets the caster

declaredRaw.label: raw special damage by caster stars (requested amount)

effects.scaling: requested = table value by caster stars (20 for Glimmet at 1 star, 40 for Glimmora at 2 stars; no unit has stars 3 or 4 in this record). Applied: x(1 + caster AP / 100) (apBoost default true), x2 if the caster is enraged, crit factor 1 + (critPower - 1) x reduction only if crit (crit needs ABILITY_CRIT because canCritByDefault is false)
effects.resolution: no damage if the victim has protect, skydiving or magicBounce (magicBounce can reflect part to the caster). Then PokemonState.handleDamage: special damage / (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef) with the victim's armorReduction halving speDef, minimum 1 after Math.ceil, shield absorbs first. takenDamage (returned but unused here) includes shield damage and is capped for the hp part at the victim's hp. Three amounts: requested = table; applied = after AP / crit / defense / floor of 1; takenDamage = shield + hp actually lost.

effects.target: each adjacent enemy that targets the caster
effects.scaling: no AP scaling; +1 poison stack per hit (cap 3, 4 with VENOMOUS or 5 with TOXIC on the caster's effects)

declaredRaw.description: moveTo(x, newY, board, true) and cooldown = 500

effects.resolution: one row: BLUE caster -> y+1 if y+1 < 6, else y-1 if y-1 > 0; any other caster team -> y-1 if y-1 > 0; if neither holds newY stays -1 and there is no push. The move also requires (x, y+1) to be empty (off-board counts as empty), even when the direction is y-1. moveTo does nothing if the victim (or an occupant of the destination) cannot be moved (skydiving, locked, Heavy Duty Boots); when the destination is occupied (only possible toward y-1) the occupant is swapped to the victim's origin. cooldown = 500 is set after the call even if moveTo returned early.

statusEffects.target: each adjacent enemy that targets the caster
statusEffects.scaling: requested = table value by caster stars (4000 for both listed units); no AP factor. Each application adds one stack.
statusEffects.resolution: Requested vs applied. Applied only if the victim has no IMMUNITY_POISON and no rune protect. Stacks +1 up to 3 (4 VENOMOUS, 5 TOXIC on the origin). Duration after SWIFT_SWIM x0.7 / HYDRATION x0.5 / WATER_VEIL or SURGE_SURFER x0.3 and Odd Keystone -10% each; it only replaces poisonCooldown when longer. Each 1000 ms the victim takes TRUE damage 5% of its maxHP x stacks (reduced by rain, Assault Vest, TOXIC_BOOST, water abilities; minimum 1), with the caster as attacker. A Pecha Berry holder eats it on application.

starBehavior.note: Both tables are indexed by the casting entity's stars (fallback 160 / 16000). Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Only enemies in the 8 surrounding cells that are targeting the caster are affected. Push direction depends on the caster team and on row bounds; the free-cell check uses y+1 in all cases (off-board counts as free).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state. Each cast spends maxPP of PP. Poison stacks accumulate across casts up to the cap; a new application only lengthens poisonCooldown. Entities are evaluated from the adjacent-cell list captured before any displacement; the code does not re-read positions for later neighbours.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: special damage 20 (Glimmet) / 40 (Glimmora) raw, poison 4000 ms and +1 stack, one-row push. Applied: damage after AP, enrage, crit, speDef and the floor of 1; poison after immunity / rune protect, stack cap and duration reductions; push only if the free-cell check and canBeMoved allow it.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence, canCast, target acquisition) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution - only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was located
Pecha Berry effect (eatBerry), magicBounce reflection details and the moving state / retargeting after moveTo were not traced
How poisonCooldown counts down and ends the poison (updatePoison start-of-update logic) was only partly read
unresolved: Whether a victim killed by the special damage is still poisoned and pushed (the strategy does not check death after handleSpecialDamage; whether dead entities remain on board.cells was not traced)
Whether enemies can have targetX/targetY pointing at the caster while not actually attacking it (targeting is read only from those fields)
Whether the listed units ever reach a different star count than the bare factory value
